query_text: my service canada account log in

action.query: My Service Canada Account sign in official
queries: My Service Canada Account sign in official

annotations.title: My Service Canada Account: Sign in or register with your province - Canada.ca

content.text:
To log in to **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, use the official Canada.ca page:

**Go to:** **canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount** ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

Then choose one of the sign-in options:

- **Interac® Sign-In Partner** — use your online banking login
- **GCKey** — use a Government of Canada username/password
- **Provincial sign-in** — available for **BC Services Card** or **Alberta.ca Account** only ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/province.html?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** Don’t bookmark the secure sign-in page after you log in; start from the Canada.ca MSCA page each time to avoid login errors. MSCA also uses mandatory multi-factor authentication. ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))
